facts.fact: 不锈钢滚珠炸弹以每秒超过 25,000 英尺的速度向外爆开。
facts.anchor: The stainless-steel ball bearings blasted outward at more than 25,000 feet per second.

facts.fact: 约旦三面间谍（一名医生）最先死亡，死前微笑着低声用阿拉伯语念诵“万物非主，唯有真主”。
facts.anchor: The Jordanian triple agent, a medical doctor, died first, smiling and quietly uttering to himself the words “There is no god but God” in Arabic.

facts.fact: 两名军官正快速冲向约旦医生时，他在前进作战基地健身房旁引爆了随身暗藏的炸弹。
facts.anchor: both moving rapidly toward the Jordanian doctor when he set off his hidden bomb next to the gym building at Forward Operating Base █████

facts.fact: 这两名军官（前特种部队士兵与前海豹突击队员）各自听到的最后一句话是他向安拉的祈祷。
facts.anchor: The last thing each of them heard was his prayer to Allah.

facts.fact: 基地负责人也死了，她手捧的柠檬海绵生日蛋糕被当场汽化。
facts.anchor: The lemon sponge birthday cake she was carrying was vaporized.

facts.fact: 另有四名 CIA 官员当场死亡（其中一名站在五十英尺外），还有六人受伤。
facts.anchor: Four other CIA officers died on the spot, including one standing fifty feet away. Six more were wounded.

facts.fact: 众人原本准备为约旦人的到来唱“生日快乐”，但再没有时间唱了。
facts.anchor: Everyone was getting ready to sing “Happy Birthday,” but they never had the time.

facts.fact: 飞溅的金属切穿了约旦特工乘坐前来的红色斯巴鲁旅行车，杀死车另一侧的三个人。
facts.anchor: The flying metal cut right through the red Subaru station wagon in which the agent had arrived, killing three people standing on the other side.

facts.fact: 死者中包括一名约旦情报机构代表和斯巴鲁车的阿富汗司机。
facts.anchor: Among the dead was a representative of the Jordanian intelligence service, as well as the Afghan driver of the Subaru.

facts.fact: 匿名机构官员把这次反间谍失误归咎于基地负责人。
facts.anchor: blame for the counterintelligence lapse was assigned to the Chief of Base.

facts.fact: 匿名官员透露，她无视了中情局总部最后一刻打来的直接命令——命令要求她在把特工带进基地前彻底搜身。
facts.anchor: she had disregarded a direct order called in at the last minute from CIA Headquarters instructing her to search the agent thoroughly before bringing him onto the compound.

facts.fact: 中情局发言人发表了一份官方声明。
facts.anchor: CIA’s spokesman issued an official statement.
